node.label: Cyclones
node.summary: Cyclones hitting India's coasts and the disaster response.

facts.text: Disaster response chain: IMD warnings, State evacuation, NDRF (a statutory force under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**).
facts.plain: Disaster response chain: IMD warnings, State evacuation, NDRF (a statutory force under the Disaster Management Act, 2005).

facts.text: Tamil Nadu sent **500** electricity staff in 25 teams to restore power in Andhra Pradesh.
facts.plain: Tamil Nadu sent 500 electricity staff in 25 teams to restore power in Andhra Pradesh.

facts.text: **Cyclone Arnab** forced the evacuation of **1.6 lakh** people in Odisha.
facts.plain: Cyclone Arnab forced the evacuation of 1.6 lakh people in Odisha.

facts.text: **Cyclone Murasu** made landfall between **Ongole and Nellore** (Andhra Pradesh) with gusts up to 120 km/h; NDRF deployed 14 teams.
facts.plain: Cyclone Murasu made landfall between Ongole and Nellore (Andhra Pradesh) with gusts up to 120 km/h; NDRF deployed 14 teams.

facts.text: **Cyclone Murasu** was expected to make landfall on Tuesday between Nellore and Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh) with gusts up to 120 km/h, days after **Cyclone Arnab** killed five, submerged 3.5 lakh hectares of crops, damaged 2,425 km of roads and ~15,000 electric poles, and caused an estimated ₹4,600 crore in losses; AP put five districts (SPSR Nellore, Prakasam, Guntur, Bapatla, Krishna) on red alert and mobilised 1,688 medical teams and 116 relief camps.
facts.plain: Cyclone Murasu was expected to make landfall on Tuesday between Nellore and Narsapur (Andhra Pradesh) with gusts up to 120 km/h, days after Cyclone Arnab killed five, submerged 3.5 lakh hectares of crops, damaged 2,425 km of roads and ~15,000 electric poles, and caused an estimated ₹4,600 crore in losses; AP put five districts (SPSR Nellore, Prakasam, Guntur, Bapatla, Krishna) on red alert and mobilised 1,688 medical teams and 116 relief camps.

facts.text: A low-pressure area over the South Andaman Sea was expected to intensify into a depression and a cyclone over the southeast **Bay of Bengal**; A.P. CM Chandrababu Naidu ordered ₹54,000/hectare compensation for coconut damage from the earlier cyclone.
facts.plain: A low-pressure area over the South Andaman Sea was expected to intensify into a depression and a cyclone over the southeast Bay of Bengal; A.P. CM Chandrababu Naidu ordered ₹54,000/hectare compensation for coconut damage from the earlier cyclone.

facts.text: Andhra Pradesh relief for Cyclone Arnab: **₹5 lakh** ex gratia per death, ₹25,000/ha input subsidy, ₹18,000/ha for aquaculture ponds; 12,500 trees fell in West Godavari; the **Coconut Board** will help revive plantations.
facts.plain: Andhra Pradesh relief for Cyclone Arnab: ₹5 lakh ex gratia per death, ₹25,000/ha input subsidy, ₹18,000/ha for aquaculture ponds; 12,500 trees fell in West Godavari; the Coconut Board will help revive plantations.

facts.text: Cyclone Arnab's rain flooded south Odisha: **Patrapur (Ganjam)** recorded **546 mm** in 24 hours; NH-326 (Berhampur-Mohana) was washed away; 42,500 people marooned in Ganjam; the **Rushikulya, Vansadhara and Mahendratanaya** rivers were in spate; the Coast Guard used an **ALH Mk-III** helicopter.

facts.text: Andhra CM **N. Chandrababu Naidu** put Cyclone Arnab losses at **₹4,600 crore** and seven deaths; **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Konaseema** district was worst hit (8,000 poles uprooted); ₹1,500 per fallen coconut/oil palm tree; a low-pressure area over the south Andaman Sea was expected to become a depression.
